basic_info.description: First time on market in 54 years! An opportunity for buyers with vision! Level Up Group is excited to present a well-located duplex in the heart of Central Richmond, directly across from Golden Gate Park. This property offers unique potential for fast-track condo conversion. Whether you're looking to invest or settle into a new home, 5414-5416 Fulton St offers a world of possibilities.    The building will be delivered vacant and features two spacious full-floor flats, each with two bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms.     Both units include:     *Charming wood-burning fireplaces    *Formal dining rooms    *Breakfast nooks with built ins    *Laundry hook ups    *Classic 1920s period details        Dual-pane windows are installed throughout, ensuring a peaceful and efficient home environment. The garage includes permitted bonus rooms that present the potential for an ADU, along with independent parking for two-three cars and ample storage space. Buyers will appreciate the large yard, perfect for creating a customized outdoor oasis.    Tax records show square footage as 2,860. Graphic artist measured at 3663. Buyers are encouraged to verify square footage, permit status, and condo conversion eligibility to their own satisfaction.    Showings by appointment. Mornings are best.
